article_title: Xcos on Web as a promising learning tool for Bachelor's of Electromechanics modeling of technical objects
citation: Y. O. Modlo, S. O. Semerikov. (2015). Xcos on Web as a promising learning tool for Bachelor's of Electromechanics modeling of technical objects. http://xcos.fossee.in/
title: Xcos on Web — a cloud service for building imitative models of technical objects in a mobile Web browser
description: Xcos on Web is a web service that lets users build imitative simulation models of technical objects, including electromechanical systems, directly in a mobile Web browser. Its main window contains a model-building area and a block palette — a library of elements that are dragged into the model area and connected by link lines. The article presents it as the tool that solves Scilab Cloud's lack of Xcos access, with the project goal "відтворити повнофункціональну версію Scilab Xcos з доступом через мобільний Web-браузер". The article demonstrates it with a DC motor model built in the service.
requirements: Access through any mobile Web browser; the project aims to reproduce full Scilab Xcos functionality
constraints: The project is still at the preliminary development stage, so not all block settings are available
target_learning_goals: Modeling of technical objects, including electromechanical systems
examples: The article shows a DC motor model built in Xcos on web, with blocks dragged from the palette and connected by lines, and an XML fragment of the model representation
